introHtml: Black sun visor clips offer a sleek, professional look that blends seamlessly into any vehicle interior. Whether you need to hold parking passes, ID cards, or garage door openers, these clips provide a clean, unobtrusive branding opportunity. Available in styles like the Power Clip or Keep-It Clip, they can be screen printed or debossed with your logo. Ideal for safety managers or marketing teams equipping fleets or field staff with practical, everyday carry items.
